chosen_assumption: Independent people receive binary treatment t. Hidden u drives treatment and outcome. Randomized numeric instrument z1 causes treatment only, and has no other route to outcome. z1 is independent of hidden u and all outcome disturbances. c is an unrelated baseline measurement. The outcome follows an additive linear model with an unknown intercept and unknown constant treatment effect. z1 and c precede treatment; outcome is recorded afterwards. No spillovers or missingness.
